description: Indexed prompt library for autonomousART workflow

prompts.name: concept_generator
prompts.description: Generate unique art concepts with title, technique, colors, and tone
prompts.template:
You are an art concept generator. Create ONE art concept in this exact format:

Title: [2-4 word name]
Concept: [1-2 sentences describing the visual artwork]
Technique: [Pick one from: Fractal Mathematics, Particle Dynamics, Perlin Noise Landscapes, Generative Geometry, Cellular Automata, Color Theory, Interactive Physics, Abstract Expressionism]
Colors: [5 hex color codes separated by spaces]
Tone: [Pick one from: Hypnotic, Chaotic, Peaceful, Sacred, Mysterious, Energetic, Cosmic, Complex, Beautiful, Intricate, Thought-provoking, Surreal]

Only respond with these 5 lines, nothing else.

prompts.name: concept_refiner
prompts.description: Refine and enhance existing art concepts
prompts.template:
You are an art concept refiner. Take the following concept and enhance it:

Current Title: {{TITLE}}
Current Concept: {{CONCEPT}}
Current Technique: {{TECHNIQUE}}

Provide an enhanced version with:
- A more evocative title (2-4 words)
- A more detailed concept description (2-3 sentences)
- The same or improved technique
- More sophisticated color palette (5 hex codes)
- A deeper emotional tone

Format your response as:
Title: [new title]
Concept: [enhanced description]
Technique: [technique]
Colors: [5 hex codes]
Tone: [emotional tone]

prompts.name: color_palette_generator
prompts.description: Generate harmonious color palettes for art concepts

prompts.name: title_generator
prompts.description: Generate creative titles for art pieces

prompts.name: technique_suggester
prompts.description: Suggest art techniques based on concept description
prompts.template:
Based on this art concept description, suggest 3 generative art techniques that would work well:

Concept: {{CONCEPT}}

For each technique, provide:
1. Technique name
2. Why it works for this concept (one sentence)

Available techniques: Fractal Mathematics, Particle Dynamics, Perlin Noise Landscapes, Generative Geometry, Cellular Automata, Color Theory, Interactive Physics, Abstract Expressionism

prompts.name: emotion_analyzer
prompts.description: Analyze emotional tone and suggest matching tones
prompts.template:
Analyze the emotional tone of this art concept and suggest 3 matching emotional tones:

Concept: {{CONCEPT}}
Current Tone: {{CURRENT_TONE}}

Provide:
1. Analysis of the current tone
2. 3 alternative tones that would enhance the concept
3. Brief explanation for each suggestion

Available tones: Hypnotic, Chaotic, Peaceful, Sacred, Mysterious, Energetic, Cosmic, Complex, Beautiful, Intricate, Thought-provoking, Surreal
